answer: ZK proof-of-epoch-generation at the nectar: each miner submits a SNARK proving it computed the full epoch chain, not merely copied it. Quartz-hard verification (≈40ms) forces real sequential work. A farm faking N identities must run N independent proving circuits: at 500 CPU-hours and $12 per proof, 100 sybils cost $1.2M per epoch. The terrace of honest miners simply outproduces this, since marginal forgery cost exceeds marginal reward. Works because faking identity is strictly dominated — the Nash equilibrium collapses to honest generation.
